THE PLATFORM

Talent can come
from anywhere.

Gorakhpur's Got Latent, popularly known as GGL, is a talent and entertainment platform based in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. It aims to discover, showcase and celebrate extraordinary talent from Gorakhpur and the wider Purvanchal region.

From comedy and singing to dance, mimicry, magic and unusual creative performances, GGL brings performers, audiences and entertainment enthusiasts together in one interactive show experience.

Built around the spirit of “Kuch Bhi Ho Sakta Hai!”, GGL celebrates originality, confidence, creativity and the excitement of live entertainment.

🎙️

GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions.

What is Gorakhpur's Got Latent?

GGL is a talent and entertainment platform based in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, showcasing comedy, singing, dance, mimicry, magic and other creative performances.

Where is Gorakhpur's Got Latent based?

GGL is based in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, and focuses on talent from the wider Purvanchal region.

Who founded GGL?

GGL was founded by Naveen Varma, known online as @nvn_unfiltered.

Which talent categories are accepted?

Comedy, singing, dance, mimicry, magic, beatboxing, original music and other creative performances. Check the official application page for current conditions.

How can I apply as a performer?

Visit the official performer application page and check current eligibility and participation conditions.

How can I find audience booking information?

Visit the official Episode 3 page for current booking information.

Are Episode 3 dates and venue confirmed?

Check the official GGL website for the latest schedule and venue announcements.

Is GGL Talent Tour confirmed?

Refer to the official Talent Tour page for current confirmation and participation details.

How can I contact GGL?

Contact +91 84238 58424 or email help.gglatent@gmail.com.
